summary.text: Hua Qiao Pavilion is where Master Hua waits for You Chan in Nan Gong clan waters. An Immortal Gu House with a central pavilion appears next, so this page treats the name as that house by implication.

claims.text: When You Chan reaches Nan Gong clan sea territory seeking help, a Nan Gong clan Gu Immortal welcomes her and says Master Hua is already waiting at Hua Qiao Pavilion. She follows him through undercurrents and then sees an Immortal Gu House in the sea, specially constructed with a pavilion in the center that holds stone tables and chairs, where Hua An is brewing tea. The chapter does not name that house in the same line as Hua Qiao Pavilion; this page infers the wait place as that house from the arrival sequence. Inside, he greets her, seats her, and drinks tea with her while they talk as old friends; he is one of Eastern Sea’s three publicly named wisdom path experts and lives under Nan Gong clan protection after leaving Hua clan. From that meeting he tries and fails to deduce the background of the person competing with You Chan in the dragonfish business, then explains how a rank six concealment blocks wisdom path deduction like a dam across a river.

Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because the wait at Hua Qiao Pavilion is followed by sight of an Immortal Gu House with a central pavilion. The name is treated as that house by implication, not by a direct naming line. It is mobile or seaborne equipment in Nan Gong clan waters, not a five-region map seat.
